definition: מִשְׁפְּתַ֫יִם noun [masculine] dual probably fire-places or ash-heaps (namely, of the villages or encampments of the tribe) (> Ki Thes and most sheepfolds , see Stu Ju ); — בֵּין הַמִּשְׁפְּתַ֫יִם Judg 5:16 (poem; compare GFM ); so ( תָּ֑יִם -) Gen 49:14 (poem in J ).
